test_name: Haptics stuck on forever after losing an arm - b29b7e66-99b3-440c-9e7f-2b4732418639
summary: Inconclusive because the Unity editor never finished loading, so the fix was not compiled or tested in game. The cause is the arm's slowdown buzz after a punch or recoil: it keeps pulsing until the arm recovers, but an arm that gets destroyed during that slowdown never recovers, so the buzz runs until the mech dies. The fix stops that buzz as soon as the arm is dead.
